build_hrnet_backbone: build an HRNet backbone with 4 stages for semantic segmentation multi-scale feature extraction
create_hrmodule: create an HRModule with multiple branches and fusion layers for high-resolution feature exchange
build_transition_layer: build a transition layer to adapt channel dimensions between HRNet stages
freeze_hrnet_stages: freeze HRNet backbone stages to stop gradient updates during fine-tuning
forward_hrnet_multiscale: run forward pass through HRNet to get multi-scale feature maps at different resolutions
